title: Niagara Artists Centre

services.name: Apply to Exhibit
services.desc: This program supports Ontario-based artists and artist collectives working in visual arts, craft and media art practices in the presentation of their artwork in a confirmed public exhibition. This is a third-party recommender program. Using Nova, OAC’s online grant application system, artists apply to the galleries and organizations designated as recommenders for the program. These recommenders assess applications and submit grant recommendations to OAC. Niagara Artists Centre is located on the ancestral lands of the Haudenosaunee and Anishinaabe peoples. This territory is covered by the Upper Canada Treaties and is within the land protected by the Dish with One Spoon Wampum

services.name: NAC Studio Rentals
services.desc: The NAC Studio is located a block north of the Niagara Artists Centre in St. Catharines and offers affordable studios for fourteen NAC member artists. The studios vary in size and cost and include semi-private as well as shared artist workspaces. Rents begin at $100 per month and are subsidized by an investment from the Ontario Trillium Foundation’s Seed Program. blurb: SEED TRAY is the latest chapter of the multipart S LOWER F, an ongoing project driven by research-creation methodologies of slowness, play, healing, and deep time engagements as acts of resistance and refusal. This new installation compiles the residual works on paper from the previous four chapters as a living archive.
